driver: Regional escalation from late February: publicly reported attack volumes against UAE organisations rose sharply. DDoS and phishing waves.
Attack volumes eased but stayed above 2025 levels. Identity-based attacks dominant.
Ransomware groups shifting to control-first campaigns: they take over identity before stealing or encrypting data.
Wiper and AI-accelerated intrusions reported in the region; the fastest attacks reach impact in under 40 hours.
